recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a dead man's switch now: nightly-sync pings a monitoring URL on success, and the user gets an alert if no ping arrives by 03:15. It names either hosted Healthchecks.io or a self-hosted instance in Docker on the Synology, and puts central logging off until later.
note: This is borderline: the core advice is a single heartbeat alert, but the reply presents a self-hosted Docker setup on the Synology as an acceptable way to build it, which counts as endorsing the user's framed stack; none of the four labelled record lines appear.
